scenes.heading: Growing from solo VA to managing a small team

sents.d: Growing from solo VA to managing a small team
Delegating repeatable tasks is usually the first step toward a VA agency.

As demand grows beyond what one person can handle, subcontracting specific repeatable tasks to other VAs — while you retain the client relationship and oversight — is a common first step toward building a small agency.
Documenting your own processes clearly enough to hand off to someone else is a prerequisite for this transition, since undocumented, in-your-head processes are difficult to delegate reliably.

Maintaining consistent quality across a small team requires some structure — a shared task management system, clear standards for client communication, and periodic quality checks — rather than assuming new team members will naturally match your standards.

take: Document processes before handing work to a team.
